title: GDP Up, Dignity Down
caption: Two economists, two unfortunate meals, and $200 of supposedly impressive economic activity.
explanation: Elon Musk retells the two-economists joke: a playful jab at confusing money changing hands with meaningful progress. Watch the linked clip for the full delivery.
creator: Alvin Foo

title: Science! Results Pending.
caption: Confidence: 100%. Reproducibility: we will get back to you.
explanation: Scientific enthusiasm is wonderful. The repeat experiment still gets the final vote.
creator: Science Friday

title: Reviewer 2 Has One Small Question
caption: “Could you briefly explain the mathematics?” Three whiteboards later…
explanation: A visual tribute to the moment a seemingly small question uncovers a surprisingly large derivation.
creator: Cyberpunk 2077

title: Everything Is Fine Before the Deadline
caption: The experiment is on fire. Unfortunately, this is not a metaphor.
explanation: Deadline humor from a research institute: urgency does not always improve experimental stability.
creator: Gladstone Institutes

title: My Budget Meets the Price Tag
caption: My spreadsheet assumed constant prices. The supermarket preferred a plot twist.
explanation: A cost-of-living reaction: a budget can balance perfectly until its assumptions meet current prices.
creator: Dylan Yeandle

title: The Printer Has Entered the Chat
caption: The economic model has twelve equations. The meme has one sound: brrr.
explanation: A deliberately oversimplified money-printer meme. Monetary policy and inflation are more complicated than a GIF.
creator: eToro

title: The Forecast Is Up. Obviously.
caption: My forecasting method: rotate the chart until it looks optimistic.
explanation: A “stonks” joke about confusing an upward-looking picture with evidence. A punchline, not an investment strategy.
creator: Aktiengram

title: A Meeting About Fewer Meetings
caption: Great news: we have scheduled a workshop to discuss why nobody has time.
explanation: The coordination paradox: organizing productivity can consume the time intended for productive work.
creator: The Office

title: The Spreadsheet Is the Business Model
caption: The strategy was ambitious. Then someone opened the spreadsheet.
explanation: A spreadsheet reaction for the transition from inspiring pitch to assumptions, formulas, and one suspicious cell.
creator: Percolate Galactic

title: Just One Last Revision
caption: The deadline is fixed. The scope has discovered exponential growth.
explanation: A familiar project-management tension: expanding requests, unchanged delivery dates, and rapidly disappearing coffee.
creator: Floik
